cascade.theme: CSS root is light. App reads axiom.ui.theme with dark fallback, then sets data-theme. Saved preferences and authored ADS themes stay independent.
cascade.sizes: Button/field/badge frontmatter heights are minima. IconButton is an explicit 40px square before compact overrides. Small Button padding and leading can exceed its 32px minimum.
cascade.managedFields: Managed fields use 40px minimum, 14px type, 1.4 leading, 10px corner and 12px inline padding. Managed selects use auto height and 8px block padding; field textareas have 76px minimum. Native fallback selects remain 32px with 4px block padding.
cascade.inspectorFields: The resting inspector field :is(...) selector is more specific than its hover/focus border rules, so transparent border persists. The shared focus-visible outline and important invalid border remain effective. This is a limitation, not prescribed hover behavior.
cascade.responsive: Shared root inspector width 348px supersedes earlier 1200px/900px widths. Later 1100px shared rules produce 200px rail and 316px inspector. Narrow base control minima do not supersede every size/toolbar rule.
cascade.type: Complete gallery recipes differ from live component recipes. Paragraphs use 1.6; buttons/managed fields use 1.4. Local branding and native fallback literals are not generalized.
cascade.sourceRoles: Frontmatter keys do not create runtime properties. on-accent and shadow-specimen-ground name source literals. No invented tonal ramp is supplied.

evidence.dispositionScope: Four scored fixes only: compact Foundation color/shadow controls, readable composite captions, seed execution record, and neutral editable borders.
limits: The reviewer examined all 19 static recaptures; the documenter extracted current source and read the report.
No whole-surface or temporal visual approval. List rendering was not captured.
The documenter reran neither detector nor browser. Functional evidence belongs to the verification record.
One detector run against stale DESIGN.md reported 45 advisory mismatches and one height-transition warning. The height transition was then removed mechanically.
The new identity has no shipping raster assets.
notCanonized: Inspector hover/focus border declarations lose to the resting selector.
Existing kicker/eyebrow selector and compact fallback literals are not elevated into house rules.
Independently authored purple is retained content, not identity drift.

narrative.overview:
Axiom UI is a precise, tactile editor whose actual values carry the visual interest. Signal lime marks primary action and selection; charcoal or chalk planes carry the work. SUIT, rounded outline icons, and generous vertical grouping give Korean and English authoring the same measured rhythm.

The interface is built directly in code. Flat structural panels, restrained glow on active navigation, and glass on floating canvas tools establish depth without competing with the authored system. This identity belongs to Studio: a person's colors, type, shadows, and motion remain independently authored content.
keyCharacteristics: One fluorescent signal color across dark and light Studio appearances.
Shared SUIT roles, rounded controls, and vertically separated property groups.
Actual material specimens connected to contextual controls and reviewed changes.
Thin SVG outlines, tonal structural layers, and purposeful motion.

rules.name: Independent Values
rules.body: Studio appearance is separate from authored ADS theme contexts and token values. Preserve authored purple, other project colors, and explicit saved appearance preferences when changing the editor identity.

rules.name: Boundaries Have Jobs
rules.body: Structural separators use line, secondary edges use line-strong, and ordinary editable fields use control-border. Inset inspector fields are a documented tonal exception; focus and invalid state still need their own visible treatment.

rules.name: Scope Shared Roles
rules.body: Use shared role variables for Studio chrome, and inspect the actual cascade before claiming every element uses a complete type recipe. Authored typography specimens render the user's value with documented display bounds.

rules.name: Elevate by Role
rules.body: Keep structural panes flat. Use floating-shadow for detached tools and dialog-shadow for modal surfaces. Preserve the stable light ground behind authored shadow specimens.

dos: **Do** reuse semantic CSS roles and shared primitives before adding another local recipe.
**Do** preserve the same role meanings in dark and light Studio appearances.
**Do** keep authored material values independent from the Studio brand.
**Do** group related measurements and leave vertical space between property groups.
**Do** pair specimens with readable names, measurement recipes, bindings, and unresolved states.
**Do** retain accessible icon labels, visible focus, reduced motion, and Korean input composition.
**Do** verify selector precedence when extending shared controls or responsive behavior.
**Do** keep review and source-provenance states explicit at the point of change.
donts: **Don't** change saved appearance or authored project values to enforce a new default.
**Don't** replace ordinary editable boundaries with faint structural separators.
**Don't** make structural panes glow or float just because active navigation and tools do.
**Don't** squeeze three desktop panes into a narrow viewport.
**Don't** substitute truncated composite JSON for a readable material caption.
**Don't** treat a static capture, catalog entry, or generated source as proof of temporal behavior or native execution.
